1719|bf4c7bb7.name: Warden Thelwater
1719|bf4c7bb7.text: Over here, you worthless...! If you want to do something useful, listen quick!

2481|014b9d07.name: Bliztik
2481|014b9d07.text:
A customer all the way out here? What luck! This place was a goldmine of empty alchemy bottles. Kinda weird.

Don't worry, I washed 'em out.

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

268|f1060a41.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|f1060a41.text: Greetings, $c! I have but one goal: the cataloging and recording of all knowledge related to the history of Duskwood and Darkshire. Perhaps you could help me in my endeavor?

272|c8dcec52.name: Chef Grual
272|c8dcec52.text: Hello, hello!  Welcome to my kitchen, sir!  This is where all of the Scarlet Raven Tavern's finest delicacies are made.  Ah, just smell the wonderful aroma!

3174|363380c0.name: Dwukk
3174|363380c0.text: Not bad. Go talk with Snarl, he just moved to Orgrimmar to study under Saru. Look for him in the $C district near Saru's smithy. Oh and he'll test you, so you better be as ready as you think you are.

3293|5bfb096f.name: Rezlak
3293|5bfb096f.text: I'm happy Gazlowe gave me the opportunity to be here and all, but this place is more dangerous than I thought it'd be. It's also really hot. And dusty. And it smells kinda weird. Ah, well! Hopefully it will be good for business.

344|d18fd3a5.name: Magistrate Solomon
344|d18fd3a5.text: Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

381|50146e32.name: Dockmaster Baren
381|50146e32.text: Well met, $C.  If you're here for business, then get yourself a brew and we'll have ourselves a talk.

382|04802d87.name: Marshal Marris
382|04802d87.text: I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

633|b8d58f51.name: Elaine Carevin
633|b8d58f51.text: It's dark times that have come, $c... All too soon will we lose everything... When the Light will forsake all but those who truly walk under the Light.

101-progress.name: Madame Eva
101-progress.text: Bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
101-progress.title: The Totem of Infliction

116-progress.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-progress.text: I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
116-progress.title: Dry Times

118-progress.name: Smith Argus
118-progress.text: What's that?  Verner sent you, you say?  Well give me his note.  And SPEAK UP!
118-progress.title: The Price of Shoes

119-progress.name: Verner Osgood
119-progress.text: Great, you're back!  Did you get the shoes?
119-progress.title: Return to Verner

121-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-progress.text: Did the General send news?  Are reinforcements on the way?
121-progress.title: Messenger to Stormwind

122-progress.name: Verner Osgood
122-progress.text: I know that greedy Argus will send someone to collect his scales if I don't give them to him soon.  Have you found those scales yet?
122-progress.title: Underbelly Scales

127-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-progress.text: You have some sunfish for me, eh?
127-progress.title: Selling Fish

1338-progress.name: Furen Longbeard
1338-progress.text:
A letter from the dwarven lands?  I wonder who would call from so far to the north...

Please, let me see the order.
1338-progress.title: Stormpike's Order

143-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
143-progress.text: Hail, $c.  What business do you have with The People's Militia?
143-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
144-progress.text: Shall we expect the People's Militia soon?  Does Lord Stoutmantle's news bode well?
144-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

145-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-progress.text: You appear to have traveled from afar, $C.  What business do you have here in Darkshire?
145-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

149-progress.name: Blind Mary
149-progress.text:
<Sob> Oh please, don't look at me!  I tore out these eyes with my own hands, but I can still feel your gaze!

I'm hideous!  Hideous!  Please, look away!!
149-progress.title: Ghost Hair Thread

150-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-progress.text: Do you have those fins?  Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!
150-progress.title: Murloc Poachers

154-progress.name: Madame Eva
154-progress.text: I sense that you have seen Blind Mary.  You have my Comb...?
154-progress.title: Return the Comb

157-progress.name: Abercrombie
157-progress.text: I need to string the Ghost Hair Thread along my door and my windows to keep out unwanted spirits.  Did you get it for me?
157-progress.title: Deliver the Thread

164-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
164-progress.text: You look a sturdy type, $c. Have you come to join our fight?
164-progress.title: Deliveries to Sven

166-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-complete.text:
$N, your bravery is remarkable.  The People's Militia thanks you for your service to the people of Westfall.  With VanCleef dead, this marks the beginning of the end for the Defias Brotherhood.  Hopefully some day soon peace will once again grace the plains of this fair land.

I salute you, Sir!
166-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

166-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
166-progress.text: How goes the hunt for Edwin VanCleef?
166-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

167-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
167-progress.text: Did you find any sign of my brother?  Is there any hope after all this time?
167-progress.title: Oh Brother...

168-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
168-progress.text: Were you able to retrieve any of my old co-worker's Miners' Union Cards?
168-progress.title: Collecting Memories

2040-progress.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-progress.text: Have you found the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, $N?
2040-progress.title: Underground Assault

214-progress.name: Scout Riell
214-progress.text: Have you been reclaiming our land from the Defias gang?  If so show me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof.
214-progress.title: Red Silk Bandanas

230-progress.name: Sven Yorgen
230-progress.text: You found what??  Please, let me see it...
230-progress.title: Sven's Camp

240-progress.name: Jitters
240-progress.text: $N, you're here!  Do you have my food?!?
240-progress.title: Return to Jitters

332-progress.name: Suzetta Gallina
332-progress.text: Greetings and welcome, master.  Have you yet tried one of our fine wines?
332-progress.title: Wine Shop Advert

34-progress.name: Martie Jainrose
34-progress.text: Is Bellygrub still at it or were you able to rid Lakeshire of the pest once and for all?
34-progress.title: An Unwelcome Guest

373-progress.name: Baros Alexston
373-progress.text: Yes? Is there something I can help you with?
373-progress.title: The Unsent Letter

89-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
89-progress.text: This bridge isn't going to build itself!  Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?
89-progress.title: The Everstill Bridge

90-progress.name: Chef Grual
90-progress.text: Were you able to find 10 Lean Wolf Flanks yet?
90-progress.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs

92-progress.name: Chef Breanna
92-progress.text: I still need five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
92-progress.title: Redridge Goulash

92748-accept.name: Alba Fairmoon
92748-accept.text:
The supplies you found point to a massive industrial operation somewhere in the Deadmines. There's no question that this is the source of the toxins plaguing the farmland of Westfall. We need to stop it, quickly.

Whatever's down there will be difficult to destroy. Go to the Dwarven District of Stormwind, and find an engineer who can supply us with some explosives.
92748-accept.title: Explosive Consultation

92749-accept.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92749-accept.text:
Industrial sabotage? You've got my attention!
We'll start with some dynamite...
92749-accept.title: A Dynamite Plan

92750-accept.name: Sprite Jumpsprocket
92750-accept.text:
I assume you want a "controlled" explosion? Not as much fun, but a good choice if you want to keep all your limbs.
I'm afraid I don't have a remote detonator--why don't you go check with the sneaky folks down at Stormwind Intelligence? They should be able to find us something.
92750-accept.title: Detonation at a Distance

93-progress.name: Chef Grual
93-progress.text: Hail, $N.  Did you get those Gooey Spider Legs yet?
93-progress.title: Dusky Crab Cakes

96139-accept.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96139-accept.text:
In dark times like these, it's important we remember our heroes as much as our foes. Darkshire would not still be standing if it weren't for the bravery of folk like the good Lady Althea or those who lost their lives at Raven Hill.

Have you read much on Raven Hill? No, of course not. Its history was wiped out along with its people. My library, impressive as it is, has little on the subject.

If you happen to find anything, I'd appreciate it if you brought it here. Those folk deserve to be remembered.
96139-accept.title: The Valor Family

96139-complete.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96139-complete.text:
This tome appears to be about the Valor family. I believe I've heard of a few of them. Good folk. Not sure they merit an entire book about them.

I'll make you a copy of the tome. If you see anything else related to them on your travels, I'll be happy to take it off your hands.
96139-complete.title: The Valor Family

96139-progress.name: Sirra Von'Indi
96139-progress.text: Have you found anything? I'm not holding out much hope.
96139-progress.title: The Valor Family

97242-accept.name: Kor'geld
97242-accept.text:
Yelmak doesn't want his apprentice breaking anything. Well, anything more than he already has.

He told me the young mixer in training has too much pride to ask for help when he really needs it. Yelmak wants to give him a taste of a particular home-brewed recipe.

Gather a mix of cattail and speargrass cuttings taken from the plants growing around the water in the Valley of Honor. I'd get them myself, but if I left the shop, Whuut would surely know we're catering to his mood.
97242-accept.title: Yelmak's Medley

97242-complete.name: Kor'geld
97242-complete.text:
This type of cattail and speargrass is unique to Orgrimmar. Drinking from Azshara mountain spring water, and nourished by the sweat and blood soaked mineral dust of our rocky land, these herbs contain potent powers locked within.

I'll give these to Yelmak, who may be able to win back Whuut's ear with a hands-on lesson.
97242-complete.title: Yelmak's Medley

97242-progress.name: Kor'geld
97242-progress.text: We discover formulations and recipes by showing old ingredients to new generations, who experiment with it in their own way.
97242-progress.title: Yelmak's Medley

97275-accept.name: Yelmak
97275-accept.text:
Whuut is a prodigy. That much is true. But he doesn't yet have the experience, wisdom, and time on the stirring rod to know how to respect alchemical processes.

He is exhausting all of the rarest and most exotic reagents we have available without pausing to practice and refine his basic skills.

Give him this potion I've brewed with a quick tonic method. He'll reconsider everything he's doing when he learns how local remedies and careful touch are the first true mastery.
97275-accept.title: Whuut's the Rush

97275-complete.name: Whuut
97275-complete.text:
Grorru--whaa?

You say Yelmak made this potion from speargrass and cattail with no other reagents? I didn't know chemists had any real need for these common plants we see every day.

Maybe he's right. There could be a lot I'm missing out on by skipping to the most rare and least-studied flora first.

$N, take your pick from one of these potions I brewed earlier. I appreciate you taking the time to visit our shop.
97275-complete.title: Whuut's the Rush

97275-progress.name: Whuut
97275-progress.text: Alright, what's next... Black Lotus, Mountain Silversage...
97275-progress.title: Whuut's the Rush

97281-accept.name: Unknown
97281-accept.text:
<Before you is a strange orb with a dull surface. When picked up a small electrical current seems to vibrate from within. Upon closer inspection, it looks as if a dark mist swirls within and every so often a small electrical spark can be seen.

It is clear the harpy was using it for some purpose. Perhaps Rezlak would be interested in this object?>
97281-accept.title: A Simmering Storm

97281-complete.name: Rezlak
97281-complete.text: Woah, where did you find a neat thing like that? Ya know it reminds me of the other thing my boss Gazlowe always used to tell me...
97281-complete.title: A Simmering Storm

97282-accept.name: Rezlak
97282-accept.text:
"Rezlack, when an opportunity comes knocking make sure you're ready to seize it." That's another gem Gazlowe taught me and that's exactly what I intend to do.

This orb doesn't seem damaged, it just looks like it's out of juice, but I've the idea to supercharge it back to full strength!

There are a bunch of thunder lizards in a gorge west of here. They have organs that hold a strong electrical charge that would be perfect for this.

Go harvest some and bring them back to me!
97282-accept.title: Stormy Potential

97326-accept.name: Thra
97326-accept.text:
Hey! You've got time to help us out! I know you do, I can tell by the way you smiled watching the game we're playing.

This spot behind Grommash Hold is nice because it's clear enough for us to set up our figures. But what stinks is we don't have enough rocks for chairs or tables.

You're big and strong... d'ya think you could carry back some medium sized rocks, smooth enough to sit on if we need a rest?
97326-accept.title: Rocks to Rests

97326-complete.name: Thra
97326-complete.text:
How can you even hold all of those boulders!

Those are great. Most even have a nice flat side, too. Now that you carried them all the way over here we can scoot them around in the dirt, right where we want 'em.

Thanks, $N!
97326-complete.title: Rocks to Rests

97326-progress.name: Thra
97326-progress.text: It's nice to not have to always sit in the dirt!
97326-progress.title: Rocks to Rests

98372-complete.name: Night Watch Guard
98372-complete.text:
The deceased Night Watchman lying before you is covered in deep gashes and cuts. It's clear to see that he was mauled by some sort of large beast.

You notice that the corpse has an unlit torch in his hand. You reach down and pry it from his stiff fingers. This could be useful in your travels through Duskwood and beyond to reveal things hidden by darkness.
98372-complete.title: An Unfortunate End

98386-accept.name: Foreman Oslow
98386-accept.text:
Orcs, gnolls, murlocs. Everything seems to be out to stop me from getting this bridge done on time. Now we have word there's an infestation of tarantulas at our lumber mill!

If you're up to earn a bit more coin, would you head over to Alther's Mill to the east and clear out their spider problem? Place is as good as useless to me if I can't safely send workers to collect shipments.

Oh, and if you see ol' Alther, tell him he owes me for cleaning up his mess.
98386-accept.title: Alther's Mill

98386-complete.name: Foreman Oslow
98386-complete.text:
The mill is that bad? That's worse than I thought.

I'm not particularly squeamish, but work's bad enough without spiders snatching up my workers. Thanks for the help, $N!
98386-complete.title: Alther's Mill

98387-accept.name: Marshal Marris
98387-accept.text:
You can't fight a war without weapons.

Though the Blackrock orcs have encroached upon these lands, their brazen efforts are not without certain vulnerabilities.

Head southeast below Stonewatch Keep, seek out their encampments, and target their weapons and supplies.

We'll see just how much of a threat they are without their tools of war.
98387-accept.title: Blackrock Blockade
